description: Use before writing or fixing svgbob ASCII-art diagrams for render_diagram (format svgbob): box alignment, rounded corners, quoted text, what styling is not supported, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier: This language cannot separate a key from a label: the text you draw is the only name. Draw the display name, put the identifier in the text only when the reader needs it (for example `n0002 engine`). Never invent identifiers.

examples.name: quoted text kept as one label
